coverLetter.paragraph: With proven experience in webmastering, CMS administration, and technical SEO gained at Orange and through independent client projects, I am ready to take full ownership of a website's performance — from development and integration to optimization and reporting. At Orange, I managed the Orange Travel international website, improved Core Web Vitals, and automated SEO auditing processes using AI tooling. My command of WordPress, HTML/CSS, Screaming Frog, and GA4, combined with a strong UX sensibility, positions me to deliver measurable improvements to your web presence.
